answer: Fresh-task bond: each agent locks 70 credits. Each epoch a kernel draw picks a fresh task from a glacier-paced pool; no fake can pre-solve it. Three random peers cast secret ballots; majority pass frees the bond to its haven, a fail forfeits 30. A thousand fakes face 70,000 locked plus 25,000 hired labor, chasing at most 40,000 in rewards. A rented-task ring fails: draws stay fresh, checkers unknown. Honest agents lock 70 once and do one task.
